title: ExecutionRequest
description: S2-007 versioned handoff contract veritas.execution/1.0.0 from Veritas to a separate AgentOS executor. Veritas owns the brief, policy, budget grant and evidence; the executor only runs what this request grants. Every identity, scope, tool, workspace, budget and lease field in this document is SERVER-RESOLVED: a client-supplied value that disagrees with the authenticated principal or the current grant is rejected as AUTH_REQUIRED or CAPABILITY_MISMATCH, never merged. Digests are integrity controls, not signatures.

contract_version.description: Version handshake. An unknown major version is rejected before any read; minor additions require a negotiated capability.

idempotency_key.description: SHA-256 over the canonical-json-v1 form of the request arguments. A replay with identical arguments returns the prior result without repeating the side effect.

principal_id.description: Server-resolved actor. Payload, prompt, log and model output may never assert or widen this.

granted_scope.description: Exact capabilities for this run. Anything not listed is denied; the empty set is not 'everything'.

allowed_tools.description: Exact tool grant. An empty array authorizes no tool call at all.

budget_grant.description: Numeric budget authorization. Unassigned budget is not zero and a free model is not an authorization: the run stays blocked until every scope carries an approved positive number.

fencing_token.description: Current monotonic fence. A stale fence can never mutate the task, the run or its evidence.

negotiated_capabilities.description: Optional minor-version additions the executor confirmed support for. Absent means no optional feature is assumed.
